scope: Actual retimed four-sampler/two-XOR circuit, external clock and reference currents; no recovered clock, physical-layout or whole-PHY acceptance. HBTtyp only.

report.scope: Four real samplers plus four native buffers and two fresh-wire XORs:114HBT/98rppd/10MIM/54bodycontacts,8040wireR/5282wireC. Original bits and explicit early/late data transition oracle. External8GHz clock,10ohmsources,500uA sampler/XOR references,1mA buffer references,150fF each sampler output,50fF each XOR output. HBTtyp models with nominal/hot/cold supply/resistor/cap conditions. No ideal internal bit regeneration, recovered clock, V/I loop or whole-PHY acceptance.
